model_note: Projections are minutes x per-minute rates with fitted spreads. Ranges are honest (83-91% of outcomes landed inside the 10-90% band in testing), but the centre does not beat the betting market: on 2,607 closing props (20-26 Oct 2026) the model's Brier score was 0.259 vs the market's 0.248. Use it for minutes, ranges and where to look, never as a win chance on its own. See MODEL.md.

players.status_detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.
Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Goodwin (calf) is out for Thursday's game against Orlando.
Fleming is out for Thursday's game against the Magic due to a sprained left ankle.
Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.
The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
